domains.name: Warehouse Stock Operations
domains.scope: Reconcile physical stock discrepancies and resolve order-line picking exceptions using count, movement, eligibility and fulfillment evidence.

skills.name: counted-stock-discrepancy-reconciliation
skills.description: Reconcile an observed warehouse count with a recorded quantity when location, stock identity or movement timing could explain the difference.

skills.name: pick-short-exception-resolution
skills.description: Prepare a fulfillment decision for a short pick when confirmed picked quantities, eligible alternatives and order constraints must be reconciled.
